id: title:benben:answer unmapped hogtower adapter routes with 501

review.posthog_relevance: Adds credential revocation routing and prevents skipping Hogtower-dependent deletion, supporting warehouse credential lifecycle and org deprovisioning.
review.reason: The change implements a new route pattern for Hogtower credential deletion and updates unmapped route handling, while also preventing Hogtower-dependent deprovisioning from skipping credential revocation. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in warehouse credential lifecycle and org deletion reliability.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation of credential revocation and route handling, but the actual benefit and adoption are not independently verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No untrusted instructions. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new route pattern for service-grant credential deletion.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Hogtower adapter to recognize v1 service-grant deletion requests and route them to credential revocation.

observations.behavior: Implements credential revocation and unmapped route handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes unmapped route responses from 500 to 501, and routes credential deletion to Hogtower credential revocation.

observations.behavior: Updates deprovisioning to not skip Hogtower 501 when Hogtower is configured.
observations.code_quote: # A 501 from the hogtower adapter means an unmapped route instead, and must not skip.
observations.posthog_connection: Prevents accidental skipping of credential revocation during org deletion when Hogtower is configured.
